    How to watch the 76ers game tonight?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    To watch the Sixers game tonight, check NBC Sports Philadelphia (NBCS-PH) for local broadcasts or stream via their app, Peacock, Hulu, or YouTube TV; check national channels like ESPN, ABC, or Amazon Prime for select games, and consider NBA League Pass for out-of-market games or the 76ers app for radio. 
    Local & Regional Options:
    • NBC Sports Philadelphia (NBCS-PH):
      The primary local channel for most games, available through cable and streaming services. 
    • Streaming Services with NBCS-PH:
      YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, FuboTV, and Peacock (with NBC Sports Philadelphia add-on) offer access to NBCS-PH. 
    National & Other Streaming:
    • Peacock: Streams select games, including Sunday Night Basketball and some NBC-broadcasted games. 
    • ESPN/ABC: Broadcasts nationally televised games, often available on services like Sling or DIRECTV STREAM. 
    • Amazon Prime Video: Carries some nationally broadcast games. 
    • NBA League Pass: Subscribe for live streaming of out-of-market games. 
    Radio & Apps: 
    • 76ers Mobile App: Offers radio broadcasts and live updates.
    • NBC Sports App: Provides authenticated live streaming of games.
    To find tonight's specific channel: 
    1. Check the official NBA.com Sixers schedule or Sixers Wire for the game's broadcaster (e.g., NBCS-PH, ESPN, ABC).
